title: gentianella carpatica
intro: Gentianella carpatica, commonly known as Alpine Rock Gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family, native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its ability to stimulate digestion and reduce swelling. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella carpatica include its anti-inflammatory and carminative effects, which help to alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome and other gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, gentiopicrin, and amarogentin, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
